Reconstructed cycle Y_(i+1)=a(Y_i+B_i), stationary V=2Da²/[r(1-a²)], exact cycle reward (E+aR)Y+J+aRB, and martingale correction M=I+c(Y_(i+1)-Y_i)/(1-a), c=1/r+ah. The conditional mean vanishes; E[J²]=4D/r³ and E[JB]=2D/r². Dividing the resulting E[M²] by E[C]=1/r+h reproduces the asserted affine v coefficient, its positive sign, and the deterministic/exponential benchmark (31/3,32/3) at a=1/2,D=r=h=1. Finite fourth moment controls physical-time renewal stopping/terminal reward; the stationary martingale CLT proves the normal limit rather than simulations.
